source_row.extraction_instructions: Server-rendered Umbraco; one un-paginated listing of ~25 upcoming events (BSH events + External events) as page-grid-item cards. Caption is 'Month D, City' with no year; year comes from the detail page timeline card / Date line / fee-block date. Fees in ul.price blocks (category header, member/non-member GBP). External events have no fees. No CPD published.

registry_comment: British Society for Haematology (events listing, server-rendered)

spot_check.site_says: Friday October 9th; 9.00-17.00; Friends House Euston; London
'Friday 22 January 2026' (site typo; fee block says January 22nd 2027, and 22 Jan 2027 is a Friday)

concerns: Listing captions have no year; year is resolved from the external-event timeline card, Date line (weekday-checked), fee-block date, else next occurrence. Dates are 24/24 sane today but a future page with none of these and a past-month caption could roll to next year.
The date beneath each fee block is a pricing/registration cut-off, not the event date; used only as a year hint.

IMG Webinar series (caption 'September 30', already past) is emitted as one course parent with 4 upcoming sessions (years inferred from fee-block year). A running series whose sessions are all past would return start_date None.
External events (12 of 24, run by third parties) have no fees on the BSH page: pricing_tiers []. booking_url is the BSH detail page, not the organiser site.
No CPD points published on any page (cardio-oncology course says CPD 'being applied for'); cpd_points None.
Webinars default to event_type 'conference' unless the intro says course/workshop/teaching session/taster day/education day. Online webinars have no city, venue None.

Cloudflare did not block curl or httpx from this home IP; forced-fallback (Playwright) run also returned 24 shells. Listing fetch has a 3-try retry. Sitemap lists ~147 historic event pages but the listing only shows upcoming ones, so none were added.
Harness LLM calls hit 429 intermittently; deterministic description/specialty backstops were used where that occurred (specialty classifier may mislabel, e.g. VTE together -> Women's Health).
